title: Flexible opportunity
description: One volunteer program with no set dates or times: the volunteer schedules with the organization. Plain-language guide: docs/EVENT-FORMAT.md, section "Flexible opportunities". Every shared field has the same meaning and the same rules as in a listing (docs/event.schema.json), and points at that definition, so the two cannot drift apart. There is no start, end, recurring or recurrence_rule: a schedule is never guessed from open hours. Unknown values: join_method and spanish_spoken use the string "unknown"; every other field that may be unknown uses null.

id.description: Stable across runs: for a hand-entered program, the id written in the city's flexible list. Never reused for a different program.

title.description: Name of the program, in the language the organization wrote it.

section.description: Section id from the city's own settings file (sections[].id), filled from the address's ZIP code as for listings, never guessed. null when not known.

neighborhood_or_town.description: Neighborhood or town, finer than area. A value the entry gives wins; otherwise the pipeline may fill it from the city's ZIP table. null when not known.

sensitive.description: true for every protest_action program, anything immigration-related, and anything flagged sensitive. When unsure, true. Same rules as listings.

signup_url.description: The organization's own page for joining or scheduling. Sign-ups and scheduling never happen on the hub.

spanish_spoken.description: Whether Spanish is spoken. "unknown" when the source does not say. Never guess.

training_required.description: Whether training is needed before starting. null when the source does not say.

last_seen_at.description: When the program was last confirmed on its source page. Shown as "last checked".

commitment.description: The time the organization asks for, in its own words, for example "2 hours a week for 6 months". null when the source does not say. Never guessed, never worked out from open hours.
